questions.question: The sum of three consecutive whole numbers is 33. What is the smallest of the three numbers?
questions.explanation: Call the smallest n. Then the others are n + 1 and n + 2, so 3n + 3 = 33, giving 3n = 30 and n = 10. The three numbers are 10, 11, 12.

questions.subject: math
questions.question: A chemist has 5 litres of a 28% solution and a stock of 35% solution. How many litres of the 35% solution must be added to make the mixture 30%?
questions.explanation: The amount of dissolved substance is conserved. Adding x litres of 35% to 5 litres of 28% must give 7 litres at 30%: 35x + 28·5 = 30(x + 5), so x = 2 litres.

questions.question: A train travels 240 km in 3 hours at a constant speed. What is its average speed in km/h?
questions.explanation: Average speed is distance divided by time: 240 km / 3 h = 80 km/h. Dividing the other way round (3/240) is a common slip.
